per_rule.rule: S_N must be unique because it functions as the row/entity key in this table.
S_N must not be null.
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N.
Account_No must not be null.
Account_No must be stored as a 4-digit account number string.
Name must not be null.
Name should follow the dominant title-like casing convention; fully uppercase or fully lowercase names should be flagged for review while preserving valid particles such as bin, binte, s/o, and d/o.
ID_No must not be null.
ID_No must follow the dominant format of one uppercase letter, followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter.
ID_No should be unique per customer record.
Race must not be null.
Race must use the canonical values Chinese, Malay, or Indian.
Gender must not be null.
Gender must use the canonical values Male or Female.
Age must be parseable as a numeric value.
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive.
Age should be at least 13 for this consumer/account-based service dataset.
Contact_No must not be null.

Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number in one of the observed approved structures: 8-digit local number, '65 ' prefix plus 8-digit local number, or '+65 ' prefix plus 8-digit local number; only digits, spaces, plus sign, hyphen, and parentheses are allowed.
Email must not be null.
Email must match a basic email structure with exactly one '@' and no whitespace.
Email should be unique per customer record.
Country must not be null.
Country must use the canonical value 'Singapore'.
Street_Name must not be null.
Street_Name should follow the dominant title-like casing convention rather than being fully uppercase.
Postal_Code must not be null.
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit numeric string.
If Name contains the particle 'Bin' or 's/o', Gender must be Male; if Name contains 'Binte' or 'd/o', Gender must be Female.
If Country is Singapore, Postal_Code must be a 6-digit Singapore postal code.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Account_No must match the Account_No recorded in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No must match the ID recorded in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Name should represent the same person name as Acc_Info_dirty.Full_Name, allowing only minor casing differences but not truncation or different names.
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
